sections.heading: Highway transportation system
sections.markdown:
# Highway transportation system

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
The guide associates even-numbered Interstate routes with east–west travel and odd-numbered routes with north–south travel. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
The guide describes an expressway as a divided high-volume highway with at least four lanes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
Freeway is another term the guide uses for an expressway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
A toll road collects a charge for use, which may involve a ticket or prepaid pass. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
The guide describes a parkway as a divided highway with substantial surrounding trees or other landscaping. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A01
On a divided highway, a median or barrier separates traffic moving in opposing directions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A01
A limited-access highway permits entry and exit at designated signed locations. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A01
The guide describes partial access as allowing connections at other streets while excluding driveways and other direct access. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A01
The guide contrasts exit-only access with other roads that permit street or driveway connections. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A01
Wider shoulders and gentler curves and grades are road-design measures intended to reduce collisions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A01
Reducing roadside obstacles can lessen injury severity when a vehicle leaves the roadway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A01
Sound pavement helps tires maintain grip and supports quicker stopping. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R13 | anchor: A01
Poorly maintained roads may present potholes, ruts and shoulder drop-offs that create driving hazards. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R14 | anchor: A01
Rain, including a light drizzle, can reduce tire grip on the road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R15 | anchor: A01
Hydroplaning occurs when tires skim on accumulated water instead of gripping the roadway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R16 | anchor: A01
Road drainage is designed to move water away from the driving surface. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R17 | anchor: A02
Grooves and rough pavement texture help tires retain traction and reduce skidding. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R18 | anchor: A02
Electronic or dynamic message signs can warn of hazards such as fog, strong winds or ice. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R19 | anchor: A02
In snowy areas, roads may include space beside the roadway for snow pushed aside by plows. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R20 | anchor: A02
The Federal Highway Administration works on roadway safety, public education and reducing highway deaths. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R21 | anchor: A02
Signs, traffic signals and right-of-way controls direct actions and stopping at intersections. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R22 | anchor: A02
Traffic-control devices communicate through their colors, shapes and displayed information. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R23 | anchor: A02
Reflective signs and pavement markings help drivers see guidance at night. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R24 | anchor: A02
Breakaway poles, guardrails, skid-resistant pavement and all-weather markings can reduce collision severity. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R25 | anchor: A02
Rumble strips warn a driver that the vehicle is leaving the road or moving toward another lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R26 | anchor: A02
Dedicated turn lanes, roundabouts and coordinated signals are measures used to reduce intersection crashes. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R27 | anchor: A02
A driver’s responsibility extends to passengers, other drivers, pedestrians and other people’s property. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec03-R28 | anchor: A02
Safe road sharing requires obeying traffic law and treating other users with the consideration the driver would want in return. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]
